a: Project-based time on IBM quantum processors beyond the free Open Plan, with technical support; no stated maximum
e: IBM awards quantum hardware time for novel, utility-scale research projects at eligible research institutions. Applications must come from a tenure-track faculty member or permanent research staff lead; students use the Open Plan or a professor's classroom account.
n: IBM Quantum Credits (research access to IBM quantum hardware)
unv: Award size and credit validity period are set per award and not published
